title: Touch All
features:
A very basic Touch All script, also works in a lot of games other than Be An SCP Or Guard

Modes

Normal — Teleport to all players one by one in order. 
Lock — Continue to teleport to the locked/selected player. 
Random — Teleport to all players in a random order. 
Nearest — Always choose the closest player. 
Cycle — Better Version for Normal Mode
Hunter — Always choose the player who is furthest. 
Ping-Pong — The order in which the player advances, then goes backwards, and then advances again. 
Survivor — Teleport to all valid/living players. 
Last — Teleport back to the player who was last targeted.

My recomendation is to set the delay to 0s, work best if you are SCP 457 since you can heal by damaging people.

Note:

Selecting a team on the menu does not lock it in; it means you are skipping or ignoring that team.
